meta.bit_reading_note: each position measures one round of disjoint pairs (rounds, by order); pair i of that round is bits 2i and 2i + 1
meta.description: Day 3 of 3: one job of 12 circuits (circuit A, no offset and offset), every edge of ibm_fez in its round, in the mirror order, 4000 shots per circuit (8000 per variant per edge).
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0; in each circuit, pair i of its round (in the order of rounds) is measured into classical bits 2i (its first qubit) and 2i + 1 (its second)
